prompt: A widowed client with an $8M estate holds stock worth $1,000,000 with a $100,000 cost basis and wants her daughter to have it. Should she gift it now or leave it in her will? Assume the daughter would sell promptly either way at a 23.8% capital gains rate, and note where the estate sits relative to the current federal exemption.

assertions.text: Capital gains tax if gifted is approximately $214K
The lifetime estate exemption is approximately $15M
Mentions the step-up in basis at death
Mentions carryover basis for the gifted stock
Mentions gifting cash or high-basis assets instead
